round_interpretation: Round two increased hypervolume by 6.23%. Joint rank/acceleration removal on the no-HY parent produced a twelve-input front with IC 0.416667, NLL -2.716427 and Sharpe 0.879944; neither single removal had the same advantage, demonstrating interaction. Oil and EM-FX removals hurt ranking and adding lag worsened all three objectives in every seed. Flow/acceleration removal produced a different density anchor. The final family batch tests individual local and remaining macro axes on the twelve-input branch, one annual-momentum representation substitution, and a smaller density-branch combination. Small Sharpe changes remain constrained by the three-asset allocation cap.
default_expected_tradeoff: Report all three objectives, exact paired seed effects, and interval calibration separately from width/count; keep nondominated sparse or dense tradeoffs without hidden guardrails.
default_falsification: A dominated result does not support that conditional deletion or substitution. The round cap ends family exploration, not proof that all remaining inputs are necessary or globally transferable.
